98.fr:

cet alarme, il suffit de donner AMOR_FLUI = "NON" dans DYNA_VIBRA.
98.en:
You are using MATR_AMOR and MATR_IMPE_PHI at the same time. Unless you disabled the damping computation
of fluid absorbing elements in option AMOR_MECA, damping is counted twice. To disable
this warning, give AMOR_FLUI = "NON" in DYNA_VIBRA.
